exposure: family history of asthma (mother, father, or sibling)
cohort: The study included 5314 children from 9 US birth cohorts, enrolled prenatally and included in analyses if they had 3 or more Atopic Dermatitis (AD) assessments across the first 84 months of life.
finding: In this study, five distinct phenotypes of atopic dermatitis (AD) were identified, and the timing of AD expression was significantly associated with an increased risk for different atopic march pathways, including food allergy, allergic rhinitis, and asthma.
